# ESWAMCU - Eswatini Multipurpose Cooperatives Union

> ESWAMCU is the apex body for multipurpose cooperatives in Eswatini, established in 2006. It supports affiliated cooperatives through representation, governance support, business advisory services, capacity building, resource mobilisation, and access to finance and markets.

Motto: Sibambene sakha umnotfo!
Vision: Leading multipurpose Cooperatives to drive inclusive sustainable economic growth.
Location: Corner of Mhlakuvane and Mancishane Streets, below Manzini Main Market, Manzini, Eswatini. P.O. Box 551, Manzini.
Phone: +268 2505 9156, +268 3502 0613. Email: info@swafcu.coop

## Pages
- [Home](/): overview and latest updates
- [About Us](/about): background, vision, mission, objectives, core values, what we do (cooperative development, business support, agriculture, finance facilitation, property management), leadership (board, management, governance) and resources (reports, forms, policies, publications)
- [Our Affiliates](/affiliates): benefits, directory of affiliated cooperatives, how to join
- [Projects](/projects): agriculture and financing programmes
- [News & Events](/news-events): news, announcements and events
- [Opportunities](/opportunities): vacancies, tenders, partnerships

Contact: use the "Contact Us" button on any page (opens an enquiry form), or the phone and email above.
